_comment: Fayetteville AR (Northwest Arkansas) — nine-stage-generation workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. NOTE this is Fayetteville ARKANSAS, not Fayetteville NC; the research keys are `nwa-*` and the batch covers Fayetteville/Bentonville/Rogers/Springdale/Siloam Springs/Farmington/Bella Vista. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Fayetteville-Springdale-Rogers, AR MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 3 MSA counties (Benton, Washington, Madison), Washington (Arkansas), Madison (Arkansas)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 12 geocoded venue(s) of 16 in this batch (observed lat 36.0464..36.4891, lng -94.3450..-94.1189).
